faqs.question: What is the attendance policy at AIMST University?
faqs.answer: Students must maintain a minimum of 80% physical attendance per course. Falling below 80% without approved leave results in Grade BR (Barred from final exams). Continuous unexcused absence exceeding 2 weeks may lead to administrative termination.

faqs.question: What CGPA is required to get First Class Honours at AIMST?
faqs.answer: To graduate with First Class Honours, a student must achieve a cumulative CGPA of 3.67 or higher (CGPA >= 3.67) upon completion of their degree program, with no active module failures.

faqs.question: What happens if a student's CGPA drops below 2.00?
faqs.answer: A student whose CGPA drops below 2.00 will be placed on Academic Probation and assigned to an academic mentor for close progress monitoring.

faqs.question: How much is the AIMST application processing fee?
faqs.answer: The application processing fee is RM 100 for Malaysian local applicants and RM 500 (or equivalent in USD) for international applicants.

faqs.question: How much is the campus and hostel deposit upon enrollment?
faqs.answer: Initial registration requires a refundable Campus/Hostel deposit of RM 500, which is refunded upon program completion subject to clearance.

faqs.question: What is the total tuition fee for the Bachelor of Computer Science (Hons)?
faqs.answer: The total estimated tuition fee for the Bachelor of Computer Science (Hons) program is approximately RM 51,100 to RM 51,200 for local Malaysian students across the 3.5-year duration.

faqs.question: What is the tuition fee for the MBBS (Medicine) program?
faqs.answer: The total estimated tuition fee for the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) is approximately RM 319,750 for local students over 5 years.

faqs.question: What is the tuition fee for Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS)?
faqs.answer: The total estimated tuition fee for the Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) program is approximately RM 294,500 over 5 years.

faqs.question: How much are the Foundation programs at AIMST?
faqs.answer: Foundation in Business is approximately RM 10,550 to RM 10,800, while Foundation in Science (Life/Physical) is approximately RM 10,800 to RM 10,900 for the 1-year duration.

faqs.question: How much does hostel accommodation cost per month?
faqs.answer: Hostel rates per student per month: Quad Sharing (Fan): ~RM 500 - RM 530 | Triple Sharing (Fan): ~RM 580 | Twin Sharing (Air-Con/Fan): ~RM 630 - RM 680 | Single Air-Con Room: ~RM 730 - RM 800+. All standard packages include 3 daily cafeteria meals, basic Wi-Fi, laundry, and 24/7 security.

faqs.question: What is AIMST's tuition fee refund policy upon withdrawal or deferment?
faqs.answer: For deferments made BEFORE semester commencement, no tuition fees are charged. For withdrawals or deferments AFTER semester commencement, full semester fees apply and refunds are subject to formal clearance from Dean, Library, Finance, and Admissions Offices.

faqs.question: What sports and fitness facilities are available at AIMST University?
faqs.answer: The AIMST Sports Complex features an outdoor Olympic-sized swimming pool, an indoor gymnasium, badminton courts, squash courts, basketball courts, table tennis tables, and an aerobics hall for student use.

faqs.question: Is there a temple on campus at AIMST University?
faqs.answer: Yes, the AIMST Sri Muniswaran Temple (affectionately known as the 'Aiya Temple') is located along the perimeter of the green campus, right behind the car park opposite the Dental Building. Main weekly Poojas take place every Friday from 12:15 PM to 2:00 PM, managed in collaboration with the Indian Cultural Society.

faqs.question: Are there prayer facilities for Muslim students and staff on campus?
faqs.answer: Yes, AIMST University provides dedicated Surau (prayer room) facilities on campus with designated areas for male and female Muslim students and staff.

faqs.question: How are daily catering and cafeteria operations structured at AIMST?
faqs.answer: Daily student and staff catering is managed through contracted internal vendors at the main Student Centre cafeteria. Hostel packages include 3 daily meals. Food options include resident stalls serving South Indian, North Indian, Malay/Halal, Western, Chinese, and vegetarian dishes. The main cafeteria operates daily until 11:30 PM (last orders at 11:15 PM).

faqs.question: What are the hostel curfew hours and campus entry regulations?
faqs.answer: Hostellers must return to campus and be inside their respective hostel rooms by 12:00 Midnight (curfew runs 12:00 AM – 6:00 AM). Non-hostellers must leave the campus grounds by 8:00 PM. Hostel block back/grill gates are locked daily at 9:00 PM and reopen at 5:00 AM, with specific monitored staircases remaining accessible for late night entry.

faqs.question: What is the security procedure when leaving or entering campus after 8:00 PM?
faqs.answer: Students leaving or entering the campus main gate after 8:00 PM must present their physical Student ID card and log their personal details and time in the IN/OUT logbook at the main security post.

faqs.question: Is cooking allowed inside hostel rooms?
faqs.answer: Cooking inside hostel rooms is strictly prohibited and subject to disciplinary penalties. However, students are permitted to use an electric kettle to boil hot water. Wall socket loading must not exceed 13 Amps.

faqs.question: What is the dress code for students on campus and during classes?
faqs.answer: During academic hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM), students must wear formal attire or tidy casual wear (collared shirts/blouses and slacks/jeans). Faded/tattered jeans, sleeveless tops, shorts, collarless T-shirts, and slippers are strictly forbidden in administrative and lecture areas. Traditional attire is permitted on Fridays.

faqs.question: Are students allowed to leave shoes in the hostel corridors?
faqs.answer: No. Shoes must not be placed or stored along hostel corridors due to fire and safety guidelines. Shoes left outside in corridors are subject to immediate removal by campus cleaners.

faqs.question: Can visitors or members of the opposite sex visit hostel rooms?
faqs.answer: Visitors of the opposite sex (including family members) are strictly prohibited from entering hostellers' rooms at any time without explicit written consent from the Chief Warden. Overnight stays by non-registered guests are strictly prohibited.
